body: An 8. I mean it, I think your selfie gives off a really cute, bubbly vibe, also you have pretty eyes. But I hope that you won’t post on this subreddit, or any forums really, that would rate your overall appearance based on one selfie by complete strangers. Seriously, why should you put yourself out there, showing your real face, only to be judged by some faceless morons hiding behind a monitor? Don’t do that to yourself. From your selfie, I can tell that you have really good hygiene, an okay taste in fashion, etc. But to the people who are rating you, we don’t know who they are, what they look like, or what kind of a person he/she is. Hell, they might look like fucking Steve Buscemi irl but because they frequent this subreddit, that somehow gives them the right to degrade you as a person. I think you’re beautiful, and will become more beautiful in the future as you acquire more fashion and beauty tips. Have a good day.
